provenance.boundaries: Exact progress callback, refs/settings/player snapshot, useCallback identity and request recorder; no React effects/timers, success callback or network.

limitations: Media-position samples are synthetic, not measured audio clocks.
No mounted React hook, song-change debounce, timers, backend transport or network completion tested.
Request recorder never calls success; submission is marked before completion and is not retried within a play-through.
